user_story: As a guest, I want to create a booking with a very long guest name so that the system handles long string inputs gracefully.

positive.title: Create booking with a very long guest name successfully
steps: Enter a guest name with 256 characters
Fill in other required booking details
positive.expected_result: The booking is created successfully, and a confirmation message is displayed.

negative.title: Create booking with an invalid guest name format
steps: Enter a guest name containing special characters (e.g., @#$%)
Fill in other required booking details
negative.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the guest name format is invalid.

edge.title: Create booking with a guest name that exceeds maximum character limit
steps: Enter a guest name with 300 characters
Fill in other required booking details
edge.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating that the guest name exceeds the maximum allowed length.
